description: This Java class defines a custom Akka HTTP directive that ensures a correlation ID is present in incoming HTTP requests. If the correlation ID header is missing, it generates a new UUID and adds it to the request context.

classes.name: CorrelationIdEnsuringDirective
classes.description: A final class providing a static method to ensure a correlation ID exists in HTTP requests, generating a new UUID if necessary.

methods.name: ensureCorrelationId
methods.description: Extracts or creates a correlation ID and applies a provided Route function with it.

methods.name: getCorrelationIdFromHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID from request headers, checking multiple header sources.

methods.name: createNewCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates a new UUID-based correlation ID and logs its creation.
